notes: Codec story mode: the three dark faction reps are written and brought online. Captain Trisha McHallan, Rahtan and Jaquet now have branching lore trees at the depth of Mr. Flesh and Father Xen, and all five contacts are callable. WHY THEY WERE OFFLINE: repEnabled() requires enabled === true. McHallan was enabled:false; Rahtan and Jaquet had no enabled key at all, which fails the identity check just as hard. All three are now enabled:true. WHY A TREE ALONE WOULD NOT HAVE RENDERED: connect() runs selectCurrentQuest() before it ever looks at rep.tree, so a tree only plays when the quest list is empty or fully completed. McHallan carried COLD OPEN inside quests[]; Rahtan and Jaquet used the legacy rep.quest shape, which the engine wraps into a one item qlist at call time. In all three cases the quest pitch wins and the tree never renders. All three now carry quests:[], the same parking pattern Father Xen already used for COMMUNION. NOTHING WAS DELETED: McHallan's COLD OPEN moved to parkedQuests, a key the engine does not read. CREDIT CHECK and BEAR RAID stay on rep.quest, shadowed by the empty array. Each questline restores by renaming one key or removing one empty array. presidentLock removed from McHallan because it short circuits in connect() before the tree branch, so the seat holder would have got one line and no lore; the {name} token already resolves to President for that player. CONTENT: 24 nodes per rep, six topics plus a work stub, one faction router each. McHallan and Rahtan were rewritten before release after their first draft read as machine written; see the changelog for the measurements and the register notes. DATA ONLY. No edits to codec.js. Validated: 184 options across five reps, every next and branch destination resolves, no orphan nodes, no zero option nodes. node --check clean, tools/lore-check.mjs 38 passed 0 failed, zero em dashes in the file. CLIENT ONLY, no restart, hard refresh required.
